description: Header file defining the SharedBuffer class for inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore synchronization, including constructors, methods for producing and consuming data, and accessors for administration data.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for sharing data buffers between processes with semaphore-based synchronization, supporting producer and consumer roles.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for consumer role, initializes shared buffer with default size.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for producer role, sets up shared buffer with specified size and mode, and locks semaphore.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests permission to produce data, locking the producer semaphore.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete and unlocks the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests permission to consume data, locking the consumer semaphore and realigning buffer.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed and unlocks the producer semaphore.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets user permissions for the buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets group permissions for the buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Gets permission mode for the buffer.
